description: Goal: collapse the old model fully once the new contract is live. Delete obsolete callable-constructor tests, side-table helpers, and comments that describe captures as prepended call arguments. Re-baseline the focused fixture set and verify the full workspace. Acceptance: no compiler2/native test still asserts callable constructor body-id vectors; docs describe callable boundaries, separate arg/capture ABI, and direct-vs-opaque closure calls; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test --workspace pass.

comments.text: IMPLEMENTATION ATTEMPT 2026-07-09: stopped without commit. Search confirms ticket is not satisfied: native_codegen/driver.rs still has build_codegen_closure_targets, and drive_test still has an expected-failure regression referencing build_codegen_closure_targets/capture-count gap. Obvious deletion path exposed a model issue: native codegen currently assumes one FnId -> NativeClosureTargetSurface, but shared Enum.find/find_value-style fixtures can produce multiple callable-boundary surfaces for the same target FnId. Correct cleanup needs a boundary-aware closure-target surface model: key explicit surfaces by boundary/direct surface, resolve direct closure calls via the closure var's boundary id when present, keep direct-only fallback for no-boundary closure calls, then delete build_codegen_closure_targets and retire the stale expected-failure test. Closure regression fixtures plus cargo test --lib and clippy were green in the attempted worktree.

title: Remove legacy callable-constructor reconstruction and retire closure regression debt
